props.heading: Cats Luv Us vs. Typical Pet Boarding

faqs.question: What makes Cats Luv Us different from other pet boarding facilities?
faqs.answer: Cats Luv Us is a cat-exclusive facility — no dogs, no stress. With 30+ years of experience since 1993 and a 4.5-star Google rating from 120+ reviews, we provide specialized feline care that mixed-pet facilities simply can't match. Our team is trained exclusively in cat behavior and care.

faqs.question: How much does cat boarding cost at Cats Luv Us?
faqs.answer: Contact us for current rates — call (949) 582-1732 or book directly online for the best prices. New customers, ask about our free night promo!

faqs.question: Can you administer medication to my cat during boarding?
faqs.answer: Yes, our trained staff can administer oral medications, insulin injections, and topical treatments at no extra charge for standard medications. We follow your vet's instructions precisely and maintain a detailed medication log for your peace of mind.

faqs.question: What should I bring when dropping off my cat for boarding?
faqs.answer: Please bring your cat's current vaccination records (FRCP within the last 3 years), any medications with vet instructions, and your cat's own food — we ask that you bring their regular food so we can follow their feeding routine. A favorite toy or blanket for comfort is also welcome. We provide litter, bowls, and bedding. Download our free Boarding Preparation Checklist (PDF) for the complete list.

faqs.question: Do you offer grooming services for cats?
faqs.answer: Yes! We offer cat grooming services including baths, brushing, and more. Book your grooming appointment at calendly.com/catgrooming. Our groomers specialize exclusively in cats and understand feline-specific techniques for stress-free grooming. Grooming can be added to any boarding stay.

faqs.question: Is Cats Luv Us licensed and insured?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Cats Luv Us is fully licensed by the County of Orange, bonded, and insured. We hold certifications in pet first aid and CPR, and we are a proud member of the Professional Cat Groomers Association of America and the Pet Care Services Association.

faqs.question: How do I book a stay for my cat?
faqs.answer: Booking is easy! Call us at (949) 582-1732, email catsluvus@gmail.com, or book directly online for the best prices. We recommend booking at least 2 weeks in advance for holidays and peak summer months.

faqs.question: What are your hours and where are you located?
faqs.answer: We are located at 27601 Forbes Rd #25, Laguna Niguel, CA 92677 — conveniently on Forbes Rd & Crown Valley, across from Costco, easily accessible from all of South Orange County, including Dana Point, San Juan Capistrano, Mission Viejo, and Aliso Viejo. Drop-off and pick-up hours are 7:00 AM to 7:00 PM, 7 days a week. Our staff is on-site 24/7 caring for your cats. We also invite you to stop by for a personal tour!

myths.myth: “Cats are fine being left alone with a food bowl for a week.”
myths.reality: FACT Cats need daily monitoring, fresh water, and clean litter. Cats left alone risk dehydration, urinary blockages, and severe anxiety. The ASPCA recommends professional care for any absence over 24 hours.

myths.myth: “All pet boarding facilities are the same.”
myths.reality: FACT Cat-exclusive facilities reduce feline stress by up to 60% compared to mixed-animal environments. The sounds and smells of dogs create chronic cortisol elevation in boarded cats, leading to appetite loss and illness.

myths.myth: “My cat will be traumatized by boarding.”
myths.reality: FACT In our 30+ years, the vast majority of first-time boarders return for repeat stays. Cats thrive in consistent, calm environments with routine care. Many of our regulars start purring the moment they arrive.

FACT Our rates are competitive with — and often less than — most pet sitters ($40–75/visit). Plus, you get 24/7 supervision, daily health monitoring, medication admin, and liability insurance — benefits no pet sitter can match.

FACT We specialize in senior cat care. Our staff is trained to administer medications, monitor chronic conditions, and provide the gentle handling older cats need. Over 30% of our boarders are seniors, and their parents trust us completely.

props.heading: People Also Ask About Cat Boarding

questions.question: How far in advance should I book cat boarding for the holidays?
questions.answer: We recommend booking at least 4–6 weeks in advance for Thanksgiving, Christmas, New Year's, and the Fourth of July. Summer months (June–August) also fill up fast. For regular weekends, 1–2 weeks notice is usually sufficient.

questions.question: What vaccinations does my cat need for boarding?
questions.answer: All cats must be current on their FRCP vaccination (feline rhinotracheitis-calici-panleukopenia) within the last three years. Please bring documentation from your veterinarian at drop-off.

questions.question: Can I visit or tour the facility before booking?
questions.answer: Absolutely! We encourage prospective cat parents to schedule a tour. You'll see our suites, meet our staff, and ask any questions. Call (949) 582-1732 to schedule your complimentary tour.

questions.question: What's the difference between your Standard and Luxury suites?
questions.answer: Contact us for current pricing — call (949) 582-1732 or book online. We offer private suites with bedding, litter, food bowls, and daily care. Both suite types include our full 5-Point Care Promise.
